query: EV battery cathode active materials import tariffs

statements.text: From 2027, the CTH route explicitly excludes non-originating active cathode materials.

From 1 January 2027, for an electric vehicle to qualify for tariff-free trade between the EU and UK: - 55% of its ex-works value must originate in the EU and/or UK; and - the battery pack must be EU/UK-originating.
Which means, de facto, that to qualify, battery packs must use EU/UK-originating CAM.

From the 1st of January 2027, the maximum non-originating materials (MaxNOM) allowed in a finished battery electric vehicle (BEV) or Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) drops from 60% to 45% of the ex-works value.
